description: This file defines several Odoo ORM models and database views related to account receivables, aged receivables, and invoice reports, including view initialization and calculation methods.

classes.name: report_account_receivable
classes.description: Model representing receivable account reports with a view for weekly data.

classes.name: temp_range
classes.description: Temporary model used for dashboard range calculations.

classes.name: report_aged_receivable
classes.description: Model for aged receivable report with dynamic view generation based on fiscal year ranges.

classes.name: report_invoice_created
classes.description: Model for recent invoice creation report with a view filtering last 15 days.

methods.name: _code_get
methods.description: Retrieves account type codes and names for selection field.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes database views for account receivable, aged receivable, and invoice reports.

methods.name: fields_view_get
methods.description: Ensures init is called once for the aged receivable view.

methods.name: _calc_bal
methods.description: Calculates the balance for aged receivable periods based on date ranges.
